## PostHog milestone feed

PostHog webhook URL:
`https://n8n.sproutify.app/webhook/posthog-event-ingest/<CONNECTION_ID>`

Add header:
`Authorization: Bearer <ONE_TIME_WEBHOOK_SECRET>`

Configure the PostHog destination filter to match the connection's allowlisted event names. Use this payload template:

```json
{
  "event_id": "{event.uuid}",
  "event": "{event.event}",
  "distinct_id": "{event.distinct_id}",
  "timestamp": "{event.timestamp}",
  "email": "{person.properties.email}",
  "properties": {event.properties}
}
```

The Supabase Edge Function verifies the bearer secret against its stored SHA-256 hash, rejects non-allowlisted events, rebuilds properties from the allowlist, and performs the idempotent database transaction. Deploy `posthog-ingest` with `--no-verify-jwt`; it performs its own bearer authentication. Never log the inbound body in n8n.
